EC2: Acute [OR] or chronic pain [AND] requiring opioid treatment
EC3: Acute liver injury (liver aminotransferase concentrations >5 times the upper limit of normal)
EC4: Health condition considered unsafe for inclusion (at discretion of PI and/or attending physician)
EC5: [NOT] Lack of capacity [OR] or willingness to consent
EC6: Currently prescribed pharmacotherapy [AND] for alcohol dependence ([NOT] not including treatment [AND] of acute alcohol withdrawal syndrome)
EC7: Previous significant adverse reaction to naltrexone [OR] or diluent
EC8: Pregnant [OR], nursing [OR], or [NOT] not using effective methods of birth control
EC9: Prisoners (as defined by Office of Human Research Protection) at the time of enrollment ARE NOT ELIGIBLE for study entry. However, subjects who become prisoners after being enrolled will be included and not be withdrawn from the study. Patients on parole or probation are eligible for enrollment.
